37
1Aane, yei ho na m’akoma tutuo,
na ɛpopo firi n’afa.
2 # Dwom 29.3 Tie na montie ne nne huuyɛ,
ne mmobom a ɛfiri n’anomu no.
3Ɔgyaa mu ɔsoro ase nyinaa,
na ne hann kɔduru asase anoano.
4Aprannaa bobom di akyire,
ɔde ne kɛseyɛ nne no bobom.
Sɛ wɔte ne nne a, ɔrensianka wɔn.
5Onyankopɔn de ne nne prannaa bobom ma no yɛ nwanwa,
ɔyɛ adeɛ akɛseɛ a yɛnhunu mu,
6 # Dwom 147.16; Hiob 38.28 na ɔka kyerɛ sukyerɛmma sɛ: Tɔ gu asase so!
ne osukɛseɛ nso saa ara sɛ: Tue! ne n’ahoɔden suo akɛseɛ no.
7Ɔsɔ nnipa nyinaa nsa ano,
sɛ nnipa a ɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa nhunu de.
8 # Dwom 104.22 Ɛnna mmoadoma kɔ wɔn atu mu,
na wɔtenatena wɔn tenabea.
9Ahum firi mpiakyire hɔ ba,
na awɔ nso firi atifi fam.
10Nyankopɔn home na ɛma nsuo nkyenkyeneeɛ,
na ɛma nsuo a ɛtrɛ nso da.
11Nsuo ara nko na ɔde soa mununkum,
ɔtrɛ ne hann mununkum no mu.
12Na ɔma no di kyinhyia sɛdeɛ n’akwankyerɛ teɛ,
sɛ ɛnkɔyɛ deɛ ɔhyɛ no nyinaa,
wiase nyinaa ne asase ani;
13sɛ ɛyɛ atenetene nti oo, sɛ ɛyɛ n’asase nti oo,
sɛ ɛyɛ n’adɔeɛ so oo, ɔma no ba ara.
14Hiob, yɛ aso wɔ yei ho,
gyina hɔ dwene Nyankopɔn anwanwadeɛ ho.
15 # Hiob 38 Wonim berɛ a Onyankopɔn susuo ho,
na ɔma ne mununkum mu hann hyerɛn?
16Wonim mununkum nkariiɛ,
nimdeɛ mu mudifoɔ no anwanwadeɛ no?
17Sɛdeɛ wo ntadeɛ mu hyeɛ,
berɛ a anafoɔ mframa ma asase yɛ dinn no?
18Wo ne no na ɛde ewiem tɔnn a ɛwɔ hɔ pintinn
sɛ ahwehwɛ a wɔaguo no trɛɛ hɔ?
19Ma yɛnhunu deɛ yɛnka nkyerɛ no;
esum nti yɛrenhunu deɛ yɛnka.
20Wɔnka nkyerɛ no sɛ mɛkasa?
Anaasɛ obi bɛpɛ sɛ wɔmene no?
21Na afei wɔnhunu hann sɛ ɛhyerɛn hyɛnn ewiem tɔnn,
na mframa twam a, ɛma ewiem hɔ te.
22Atifi fam asase so na sika firi ba,
Nyankopɔn ho na animuonyam a ɛyɛ hu wɔ.
23 # Hiob 28.12-28 Otumfoɔ deɛ, yɛnhu no;
ɔyɛ tumi mu ɔkɛseɛ,
na ɔrenkyea atemmuo ne tenenee a ɛdɔɔso.
24Enti nnipa suro no,
ɔmmu akoma mu nyansafoɔ biara.

pageProps.chapterText:
Aane, yei ho na m’akoma tutuo,
na ɛpopo firi n’afa.
Tie na montie ne nne huuyɛ,
ne mmobom a ɛfiri n’anomu no.
Ɔgyaa mu ɔsoro ase nyinaa,
na ne hann kɔduru asase anoano.
Aprannaa bobom di akyire,
ɔde ne kɛseyɛ nne no bobom.
Sɛ wɔte ne nne a, ɔrensianka wɔn.
Onyankopɔn de ne nne prannaa bobom ma no yɛ nwanwa,
ɔyɛ adeɛ akɛseɛ a yɛnhunu mu,
na ɔka kyerɛ sukyerɛmma sɛ: Tɔ gu asase so!
ne osukɛseɛ nso saa ara sɛ: Tue! ne n’ahoɔden suo akɛseɛ no.
Ɔsɔ nnipa nyinaa nsa ano,
sɛ nnipa a ɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa nhunu de.
Ɛnna mmoadoma kɔ wɔn atu mu,
na wɔtenatena wɔn tenabea.
Ahum firi mpiakyire hɔ ba,
na awɔ nso firi atifi fam.
Nyankopɔn home na ɛma nsuo nkyenkyeneeɛ,
na ɛma nsuo a ɛtrɛ nso da.
Nsuo ara nko na ɔde soa mununkum,
ɔtrɛ ne hann mununkum no mu.
Na ɔma no di kyinhyia sɛdeɛ n’akwankyerɛ teɛ,
sɛ ɛnkɔyɛ deɛ ɔhyɛ no nyinaa,
wiase nyinaa ne asase ani;
sɛ ɛyɛ atenetene nti oo, sɛ ɛyɛ n’asase nti oo,
sɛ ɛyɛ n’adɔeɛ so oo, ɔma no ba ara.

Hiob, yɛ aso wɔ yei ho,
gyina hɔ dwene Nyankopɔn anwanwadeɛ ho.
Wonim berɛ a Onyankopɔn susuo ho,
na ɔma ne mununkum mu hann hyerɛn?
Wonim mununkum nkariiɛ,
nimdeɛ mu mudifoɔ no anwanwadeɛ no?
Sɛdeɛ wo ntadeɛ mu hyeɛ,
berɛ a anafoɔ mframa ma asase yɛ dinn no?
Wo ne no na ɛde ewiem tɔnn a ɛwɔ hɔ pintinn
sɛ ahwehwɛ a wɔaguo no trɛɛ hɔ?
Ma yɛnhunu deɛ yɛnka nkyerɛ no;
esum nti yɛrenhunu deɛ yɛnka.
Wɔnka nkyerɛ no sɛ mɛkasa?
Anaasɛ obi bɛpɛ sɛ wɔmene no?
Na afei wɔnhunu hann sɛ ɛhyerɛn hyɛnn ewiem tɔnn,
na mframa twam a, ɛma ewiem hɔ te.
Atifi fam asase so na sika firi ba,
Nyankopɔn ho na animuonyam a ɛyɛ hu wɔ.
Otumfoɔ deɛ, yɛnhu no;
ɔyɛ tumi mu ɔkɛseɛ,
na ɔrenkyea atemmuo ne tenenee a ɛdɔɔso.
Enti nnipa suro no,
ɔmmu akoma mu nyansafoɔ biara.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
